army_rules.name: Templar Vows
army_rules.rules_text: At the start of the first battle round, select one of the following vows to be active for Adeptus Astartes units from your army. While a vow is active for a unit from your army, that unit has the associated ability shown in the vow: Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch; Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds; Suffer Not the Unclean to Live; Uphold the Honour of the Emperor.

options.name: Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
options.rules_text: This unit's melee attacks that target a Psyker unit have [Precision]. When this unit declares a charge, if an enemy Psyker unit is within 12 inches of this unit, you can use this part of this ability: this unit can re-roll that Charge roll; this unit must end that Charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy Psyker units.

options.name: Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the Wound roll.

options.name: Suffer Not the Unclean to Live
options.rules_text: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit.

options.name: Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
options.rules_text: If this unit has the Infantry keyword, at the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent controls it at the start or end of a phase. If the mission you are playing features Actions, this unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

army_rules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
army_rules.rules_text: If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army. If your army includes one or more units from the Black Templars Chapter, or you are using one of the Detachments found below, Adeptus Astartes units from your army lose the Oath of Moment army rule and it is replaced with the Templar Vows army rule. You cannot use the 1st Company Task Force Detachment, the Gladius Task Force Detachment or Detachments from Codex: Space Marines, and your army cannot include any Adeptus Astartes Psyker models. Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: Gladiator Lancer, Gladiator Reaper, Gladiator Valiant, Impulsor, Land Raider Crusader, Repulsor, Repulsor Executioner, Sternguard Veteran Squad, Terminator Squad.

chapter_rules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
chapter_rules.rules_text: Black Templars armies cannot include units drawn from any other Chapter and replace Oath of Moment with Templar Vows when using Black Templars rules.

detachments.name: Companions of Vehemence

rule.name: Righteous Fervour
rule.rules_text: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for Adeptus Astartes units from your army.

restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Animus
enhancements.rules_text: Chaplain or Judiciar model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer's unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Oathbound Exemplar
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. Add 1 to Advance rolls made for the bearer's unit. If the mission pack you are playing features Actions, the bearer's unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Merciless Denunciation
enhancements.rules_text: Chaplain or Judiciar model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Zealous Vanguard
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

stratagems.name: Devout Push
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
restrictions: A unit cannot be targeted with this and the Hearts Hardened to Duty Stratagem in the same phase unless it has the Chaplain or Judiciar keywords.

stratagems.name: Pious Enmity
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Chaplain or Judiciar unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that target is a Monster or Vehicle unit, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 as well.

stratagems.name: Hearts Hardened to Duty
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just before an Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.target: That Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Consolidation move, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, or the closest enemy unit if the Suffer Not the Unclean to Live Vow is active for it.

stratagems.name: Heresy Begets Retribution
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Chaplain or Judiciar unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: For the Emperor's Honour!
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [Precision] ability.

stratagems.name: Dread Crusaders
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was selected as one of the targets of that charge.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

detachments.name: Vindication Task Force

rule.name: Purge and Sanctify
rule.rules_text: Each time an attack targets an Ancient unit from your army, if that unit is within range of one or more objective markers and the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. Each time a friendly Crusader Squad unit makes a surge move, instead of selecting a surge target, you can select the closest objective to that unit. When that unit makes that surge move, each model in that unit must end that surge move as close as possible to that objective instead.

restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Imperialis of the Eternal Crusade
enhancements.rules_text: Ancient model only. Each time an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll. This is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll.

enhancements.name: Consecrating Aura
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer's unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Orb of the Emperor's Aegis
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Warden of Honour
enhancements.rules_text: Crusade Ancient model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time you roll one D6 for the bearer's Vengeful Exhortation ability, add 1 to the result.

stratagems.name: Refusal to Yield
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an Ancient model from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That Ancient model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.
restrictions: You cannot target the same model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Litanies of Purgation
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if that model's unit is within range of one or more objective markers or the target unit is within range of one or more objective markers, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Spoor of the Unholy
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [Ignores Cover] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll, that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristic, the Hit roll or Weapon Skill characteristic.

stratagems.name: Reclaim Our Honour!
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys an Ancient model from your army that has not been targeted with the Refusal to Yield Stratagem this phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army visible to that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time an Adeptus Astartes model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
restrictions: You cannot target that Ancient model with the Refusal to Yield Stratagem this phase.

stratagems.name: Recitation of the Revered
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Ancient unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Perfervid Intervention
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
restrictions: Even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.

detachments.name: Godhammer Assault Force

rule.name: Shock and Awe
rule.rules_text: Each time an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army declares a charge, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, after selecting the targets of that charge, select one of those targets; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each time a model in an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army makes a melee attack, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll.

restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Paragon of Fury
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time a melee attack made by the bearer is allocated to an enemy model, if the bearer disembarked from a Transport this turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

enhancements.name: Battle-psalm Precentor
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer's unit declares a charge, if an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test as a result of the Shock and Awe Detachment rule, subtract 1 from that Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Augur Servo-host
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

enhancements.name: Herald of Sacred Slaughter
enhancements.rules_text: Adeptus Astartes model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Dedicated Transport, that Dedicated Transport has the Scouts 9" ability.

stratagems.name: A Ceaseless Cause
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". It cannot embark within a Transport at the end of this move if it disembarked from a Transport this turn.

stratagems.name: Uncompromising Egress
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Land Raider model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: One Adeptus Astartes unit embarked within your Land Raider can disembark. When doing so, models in that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of your Land Raider and can be set up within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: Gauntlet of the God-Emperor
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes a Normal or Advance move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.name: Focused Hatred
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after you make a Charge roll for an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn.
stratagems.target: That Adeptus Astartes unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a charge move, models in your unit can move through models.

stratagems.name: Condemnatory Info-screed
stratagems.timing: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. If that Transport has the Land Raider keyword, you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.

stratagems.name: Blessed Hull
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

detachments.name: Marshal's Household

rule.name: Faith-fuelled Resolve
rule.rules_text: Friendly Sword Brethren Squad units have +1 OC.

restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Fervent Exemplars
enhancements.rules_text: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has +1 to Charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Inheritors of Sigismund
enhancements.rules_text: Sword Brethren Squad unit only. This unit has Fights First.

stratagems.name: Slayers of Abominations
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That Sword Brethren Squad unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks that target a Monster or Vehicle unit have +2 Strength.

stratagems.name: Blade of Detestation
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.target: That Sword Brethren Squad unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit. For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound, to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Unsparing Execution
stratagems.timing: Your opponent's Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit.
stratagems.target: That Sword Brethren Squad unit.
stratagems.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that enemy unit must use the Desperate Escape escape mode, with -1 to those Hazard rolls if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked.

detachments.name: The Living Miracle

rule.name: Anointed Champion
rule.rules_text: When a friendly Emperor's Champion unit is selected to fight, that model's melee attacks can re-roll one Hit roll and re-roll one Wound roll. Enhancements selected from this detachment do not count towards the total number of enhancements in your army.

restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Guiding Omens
enhancements.rules_text: Emperor's Champion model only. At the start of the first battle round, you can select up to three of the following abilities. This model has those abilities until the end of the battle: Instrument of the God-Emperor, Foreseen Paths of the Unholy, Vision of Momentous Brutality, Augury of Retribution, Omen of Sacred Intervention, and Harbinger of Judgement.

detachments.name: Wrathful Procession

rule.name: Chant of Deathless Devotion
rule.rules_text: Friendly Chaplain units have 5+ Feel No Pain against ranged attacks.

restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Benediction of Fury
enhancements.rules_text: Chaplain model only. This model's melee attacks have [Devastating Wounds].

enhancements.name: Adaptable Executioner
enhancements.rules_text: Executor model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this model's melee attacks have either [Cleave] or [Precision].

stratagems.name: Fuelled by Faith
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly Chaplain unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.target: That Chaplain unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Castigate the Demagogues
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That Chaplain unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have [Precision].

stratagems.name: Rite of Perfervid Wrath
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That Chaplain unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's melee attacks have +1 Strength.

units.name: Castellan

abilities.name: Prioritised Eradication
abilities.rules_text: Each time a model in this model's unit makes a melee attack that destroys one or more enemy units, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

selectable_abilities.name: Vehement Aggression - Passed
selectable_abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, if its Leadership test is passed when selected to fight, melee attacks made by models in that unit can re-roll the Hit roll.

selectable_abilities.name: Vehement Aggression - Failed
selectable_abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, if its Leadership test is failed when selected to fight, melee attacks made by models in that unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

support.rules_text: This model can support the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad; Infernus Squad; Intercessor Squad; Crusader Squad; Sternguard Veteran Squad; Sword Brethren Squad.

wargear_options: This model's combi-weapon can be replaced with 1 heavy bolt pistol.
This model's master-crafted power weapon can be replaced with 1 Astartes chainsword.

abilities.name: Litanies of the Devout
abilities.rules_text: While this unit is leading a unit and contains a Chaplain Grimaldus model, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

selectable_abilities.name: Temple Relics
selectable_abilities.rules_text: In your Command phase, if this unit contains one or more Cenobyte Servitor models, select one Temple Relic ability. Until the start of your next Command phase, this unit's Chaplain Grimaldus model has that ability.

selectable_abilities.name: Banner of the Emperor Victorious
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this unit.

selectable_abilities.name: Column from the Major Altar
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in this unit.

selectable_abilities.name: Water from the Stoup of Elucidation
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad; Infernus Squad; Intercessor Squad; Crusader Squad; Sword Brethren Squad.

restrictions: If this unit's Chaplain Grimaldus model is ever destroyed, all of this unit's remaining Cenobyte Servitor models are also destroyed. While embarked within a Transport, each Cenobyte Servitor model in this unit takes up the space of 0 models.

abilities.name: Vengeful Exhortation
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

abilities.name: Martial Honour
abilities.rules_text: The first time a model in this model's unit makes a melee attack that destroys one or more enemy units, until the end of the battle, while this model's unit is not Battle-shocked, add 5 to this model's Objective Control characteristic.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Crusader Squad; Sword Brethren Squad.

units.name: Emperor's Champion

abilities.name: Armour of Faith
abilities.rules_text: Once per phase, when an attack is allocated to this model and the saving throw is failed, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

abilities.name: Sigismund's Heir
abilities.rules_text: When this unit declares a charge, if an enemy CHARACTER unit is within 12" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit can re-roll that charge roll and must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy CHARACTER units. Once per battle, per army, in the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight while engaged with a CHARACTER unit, its melee attacks have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad; Intercessor Squad; Crusader Squad; Sternguard Veteran Squad; Sword Brethren Squad.

restrictions: You cannot include more than one Emperor's Champion model in your army.

units.name: Execrator

abilities.name: Remorseless Persecution
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

abilities.name: Condemnatory Annihilation
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model's unit has fought, if one or more enemy units were destroyed as a result of those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Crusader Squad; Sword Brethren Squad.

wargear_options: This model's absolver bolt pistol can be replaced with 1 pyre pistol.
If this model is equipped with an absolver bolt pistol, it can be equipped with 1 master-crafted power weapon; this model's absolver bolt pistol cannot be replaced.

abilities.name: Crusade of Wrath
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

abilities.name: High Marshal
abilities.rules_text: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model's unit and roll one D6, adding 1 to the result for every five models in this model's unit: on a 2-3, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 4-5, that enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds; on a 6+, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad; Intercessor Squad; Crusader Squad; Sword Brethren Squad.

weapons.name: Sword of the High Marshals - strike
Sword of the High Marshals - sweep

units.name: Marshal

abilities.name: Inspirational Exemplar
abilities.rules_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

selectable_abilities.name: Pious Fervour +1
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this model's master-crafted power weapon for enemy units within 6" of this model, to a maximum of +3.

selectable_abilities.name: Pious Fervour +2
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this model's master-crafted power weapon for enemy units within 6" of this model, to a maximum of +3.

selectable_abilities.name: Pious Fervour +3
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Each time this model's unit is selected to fight, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this model's master-crafted power weapon for enemy units within 6" of this model, to a maximum of +3.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad; Infernus Squad; Intercessor Squad; Crusader Squad; Sternguard Veteran Squad; Sword Brethren Squad.

wargear_options: This model's plasma pistol can be replaced with one combi-weapon.

units.name: Crusader Squad

abilities.name: Righteous Zeal
abilities.rules_text: In your opponent's Shooting phase, each time an enemy unit has shot, if any models in this unit were destroyed as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a Surge move of up to D6+2".

wargear_options: The Sword Brother's heavy bolt pistol can be replaced with 1 pyre pistol.
Any number of Neophytes can each have their bolt pistol and Astartes chainsword replaced with 1 Neophyte firearm and 1 close combat weapon.
Any number of Initiates can each have their bolt rifle replaced with 1 heavy bolt pistol and 1 Astartes chainsword.
For every 10 models in this unit, up to 2 Initiates can each have their bolt rifle replaced with one of the following: 1 heavy bolt pistol and 1 power fist; 1 pyreblaster.

units.name: Gladiator Lancer

abilities.name: Aquila Optics
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model is selected to shoot, you can re-roll one Hit roll, you can re-roll one Wound roll and you can re-roll one Damage roll when resolving its attacks.

selectable_abilities.name: Aquila Optics
selectable_abilities.rules_text: Each time this model is selected to shoot, you can re-roll one Hit roll, you can re-roll one Wound roll and you can re-roll one Damage roll when resolving its attacks.

wargear_options: This model's 2 storm bolters can be replaced with 2 fragstorm grenade launchers.
This model can be equipped with one of the following: 1 Ironhail heavy stubber; 1 multi-melta.
This model can be equipped with 1 Icarus rocket pod.

units.name: Gladiator Reaper

abilities.name: Reaping Tally
abilities.rules_text: This model's twin heavy onslaught gatling cannon has the Sustained Hits 2 ability while targeting Infantry units.

wargear_options: This model can be equipped with one of the following: 1 Ironhail heavy stubber; 1 multi-melta.
This model can be equipped with 1 Icarus rocket pod.

units.name: Gladiator Valiant

abilities.name: Priority Target Acquisition
abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack with its twin las-talon that targets the closest eligible Monster or Vehicle unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

selectable_abilities.rules_text: Each time this model makes an attack with its twin las-talon that targets the closest eligible Monster or Vehicle unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

wargear_options: This model can be equipped with one of the following: 1 Ironhail heavy stubber; 1 multi-melta.
This model can be equipped with 1 Icarus rocket pod.

units.name: Impulsor

abilities.name: Assault Vehicle
abilities.rules_text: Units can disembark from this Transport after it has Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move and cannot declare a charge that turn.

wargear_abilities.name: Orbital Comms Array (Aura)
wargear_abilities.rules_text: While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time you target that unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

wargear_abilities.name: Shield Dome
wargear_abilities.rules_text: The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save.

wargear_options: This model can be equipped with one of the following: 1 Ironhail heavy stubber; 1 multi-melta.
This model's 2 storm bolters can be replaced with 2 fragstorm grenade launchers.
